information.title: Quindectris
information.author: CoReMiLLiA Games
information.description: 🎮 QUINDECTRIS - The Ultimate 15-Piece Mixed-Block Tetris Experience! Features 8 precision triominoes (1-3 blocks) + 7 complete classic tetrominoes (4 blocks) with perfect clockwise rotation mechanics. No morphing, advanced wall kicks, hold system, ghost pieces. From tiny single blocks to massive 4-block power moves!
